en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Usman Bin Isa, from Khalid Bin Najeeh, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘An example of the violet (oil) among the oils is like an example of our<sup>asws</sup> Shias among the people’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Khalid ibn Najih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The likeness of viola oil among the oils is like our followers among the people.’”
